title: UK property listings outpace sales as conversion rates ease
summary:
New property listings in Great Britain rose 2.6% to 209,941 in July 2026, outpacing a 1.1% increase in sales agreed, according to Sprift's latest Sales Market Intelligence Report. The divergence pushed the national conversion rate down 0.8 percentage points to 54.6%.

title: A Place in the Sun acquires Property Investor Show
summary:
APITS Ltd has acquired Property Investor Media Ltd, merging the Property Investor Show with A Place in the Sun Live events. The combined events will launch in April 2027 at ExCel London and September 2027 at the NEC Birmingham.

title: Tribunal dismisses unfair dismissal claim from property manager
summary:
An Employment Tribunal in Sheffield has dismissed an unfair dismissal claim brought by a former property manager who worked at a Selby lettings agency for over 28 years. The case involved a family dispute at Harlequin Property Services, which has since ceased trading.

title: Prime London property transactions rise 14% in Q3
summary:
Transaction volumes in London's prime property market increased 14% across the capital in the three months to July compared with the same period last year. The estate agency's latest figures show a 3% rise in prime central London specifically.

title: New build homes carry £55,000 in regulatory costs
summary:
New build homes in southern England contain approximately £55,000 in regulatory and planning-related costs that are passed on to buyers, according to analysis by the Centre for Policy Studies. The embedded costs include biodiversity requirements, planning obligations, and fees that add around 12% to property prices.

title: Average parental contribution to home purchases reaches £11k
summary:
One in four adults who received parental assistance to purchase a home were given more than £10,000, according to new survey data. The typical amount provided by the Bank of Mum and Dad stood at £11,241, with significant variation in support levels.

title: Hampshire property secured with 80% LTV bridging finance
summary:
A three-bedroom semi-detached house in Andover, Hampshire, has been purchased for £255,000 using bridging finance at 80% loan-to-value. The property investor acquired the house which required substantial refurbishment work that precluded conventional buy-to-let mortgage financing.

title: Housing tech firms merge AI triage with human call support
summary:
Askporter and PropCall have formed a partnership to integrate automated triage systems with 24-hour human call handling for housing providers and facilities management organisations. The arrangement combines AI-powered categorisation of enquiries with human agents who can authorise emergency repairs up to £500.

title: Mortgage fraud cases increase across all categories
summary:
Mortgage fraud has increased across all reported categories in the first half of 2026, according to data from fraud prevention service Cifas. The figures show mortgage application identity fraud rose by 36% compared with the same period in 2025.

title: ValPal adds seller price expectation tool for agents
summary:
Property valuation platform ValPal has introduced a feature allowing homeowners to share their own price expectations alongside online valuation enquiries, giving estate agents advance insight into seller expectations before market appraisals.
